perf-fluctuation deep dive · trace-sync-points session · v11 gated-perfetto build with fence markers · campaign fence13pf-tp4-20260813T210954Z · delphi-3bda · 2026-08-13

The [Fence 1 → Fence 3] window, traced: fences as exact perfetto cut points

What this campaign adds: the two definitive sync points are now perfetto instants ("fence 1", "fence 3", category "model"), so per-token windows are cut exactly at the fences instead of derived edges — and Mike's tx "data ready" instant is captured per card inside every window. Both markers are now defaults in every perfetto build (owner rule, 2026-08-13). Findings from 16 traced draws:

  • The per-draw mean [F1→F3] window tracks the lottery: corr -0.85 (median: -0.70) — the third independent method (TSC probes on 3c51, per-token dumps, now exact perfetto windows on 3bda) to land on the same region.
  • Both lottery shapes appear in one campaign: draw_04 is a stall-mode draw (baseline median 316µs but 5.7% of windows >1,500µs), while draw_10 — the slowest draw — is a level-shifted draw (median 437µs vs the ~315–330µs baseline, stalls only 0.2%). The same two textures measured on 3c51 (§7.2.1 drift / §7.2.3 born-elevated in the fence report).
  • The tx data-ready leg is flat: first wcls "data ready" lands 12.2–16.8µs after Fence 1 (per-draw medians), corr vs TPS -0.05; the 4-card arrival spread is ~6–10µs. The dispatch edge does not carry the lottery — consistent with the earlier dispatch-skew exclusion.

corr = Pearson correlation of the per-draw statistic vs decode TPS across the campaign's 16 draws (−1 = larger exactly when slower).

Follow-up (deep-dive session, same day): a named-span analysis inside these exactly-cut windows shows the two shapes above are the SAME mechanism at different occupancies: windows fall into a ~283µs baseline, a recurring ~800µs mode whose extra time is 82% fill_logits_buffer, and severe >1,500µs stalls. Level-shifted draws move windows INTO the ~800µs mode (occupancy 21% → 38–44%) rather than slowing uniformly; host work inside the window is ~7.5µs flat in every class. Details: deep-dive-3bda/2026-08-13-09-3bda-fence-spans.html. The single open question for the mild mode: late block arrival (card/DMA) vs slow consume (host) — per-block stream-arrival stamps scoped to ~800µs-mode windows.

Update 2026-08-14: the wcls-bypass A/B (status_report/2026-08-13-03-wcls-bypass.html) answered the causal question at a higher level: with fill pinned to a constant 2.5 ms the per-token period spread stays at 99% of control and [F1→F3] decorrelates from TPS (−0.86 → −0.06). The window absorbs the jitter; it does not create it. The arrival-vs-consume question above remains open only as symptom characterization — the source hunt moves to the forward pass and the transfer phase.

1 · Identity and gates

  • Campaign fence13pf-tp4-20260813T210954Z, delphi-3bda, smoke+16/16 ok, machine restored (trio serving verified), harness exit 0. TPS 168.099–182.542 (gap 8.6%).
  • Binary install-pfgate2 (sha fb13463bf70a…): trunk 12804a812 + kvwait probes (dormant) + the pfgate emission gate + fence instants + tx "data ready" instant.
  • Perfetto config = the accepted pfgate campaign config with exactly one change: enabled_categories: "sys" removed (with it, the malloc counter). Enabled: scheduler, model, driver. Trace sizes ~55MB/draw (previous accepted campaign: ~60MB — smaller, as expected without "sys").
  • Token sha 66af1d58…93c4 identical in all 17 runs — the new instants do not perturb numerics.
  • Fence pairing exact: every window has one "fence 1" and one "fence 3"; every window carries exactly 4 wcls "data ready" instants. Window counts 3,712–3,915/draw (of 4,095 decode tokens; the shortfall is the documented 25s capture clipping of the decode tail, not a gate failure).

2 · The window tracks the lottery (exact fence cut)

Dashed line = least-squares reference. Cross-method check: on 3c51 the TSC-stamped F1→F3 median was ≈471µs at 2.7 GHz; here the traced baseline median is ~315–330µs on 3bda's faster clocks — same region, same behavior, different host baseline (do not compare absolute means across hosts; 3c51 is CLOS-capped, tron issue #3751).

3 · Two lottery shapes in one campaign

Right-hand dots = level-shifted draws (whole-run baseline up, few stalls): draw_10 437µs, draw_06 463µs, draw_15 398µs. Top-left dot = the stall-mode draw draw_04 (5.7% of windows >1,500µs on a normal 316µs baseline). A launch can draw either shape — or neither; the shape itself is part of the per-launch state, as seen on 3c51.
